items.item: Important finding at .github/workflows/ci.yml:25: The project CI still installs only pytest and ruff, so once this change merges `python -m pytest` fails while collecting tests/test_data.py (`import polars`) on every push to main and every PR; plan.md records the departure, but the spec requirement is unmet and CI goes red. [spec.md Design § Dependencies and CI (CI installs polars, pinned); intent Affected systems (CI must install the project)]

Important finding at CLAUDE.md:5: The change makes CLAUDE.md outdated: it still calls the project a package skeleton with one smoke test, gives `python -m pip install pytest ruff` (no polars, 'declares no extras') as setup, and `1 passed` as the healthy test output (now 69 passed); the run cannot edit it, so the owner needs to update it in their own PR. [REVIEW.md Framework rules: flag when the change has made CLAUDE.md outdated]
